tools.name: ardent_get_wallet
tools.description: Resolve/provision an ERC-4337 wallet for an agent_id

tools.name: ardent_wallet_balance
tools.description: Get native token (ETH) and ERC-20 balances for an agent's smart wallet. Call this before execute to verify the wallet is funded.

tools.name: ardent_simulate
tools.description: Simulate execution request before broadcast

tools.name: ardent_execute
tools.description: Execute request. In manual mode may return payment_required (402)

payment_proof.description: Optional value to encode as JSON in X-Payment-Proof header

tools.name: ardent_aave_supply_simulate
tools.description: Simulate supplying an asset into Aave V3 on Sepolia. The server compiles approve -> Pool.supply as an ERC-4337 batch.

amount_raw.description: Raw token base-unit amount. Provide either amount or amount_raw.

tools.name: ardent_aave_supply_execute
tools.description: Execute supplying an asset into Aave V3 on Sepolia. In manual mode may return payment_required (402).

amount_raw.description: Raw token base-unit amount. Provide either amount or amount_raw.

payment_proof.description: Optional value to encode as JSON in X-Payment-Proof header

tools.name: ardent_aave_withdraw_simulate
tools.description: Simulate withdrawing an asset from Aave V3 on Sepolia. Amount may be a number string or max.

to.description: Optional recipient address; defaults to agent wallet

tools.name: ardent_aave_withdraw_execute
tools.description: Execute withdrawing an asset from Aave V3 on Sepolia. In manual mode may return payment_required (402).

to.description: Optional recipient address; defaults to agent wallet

payment_proof.description: Optional value to encode as JSON in X-Payment-Proof header

tools.name: ardent_aave_repay_simulate
tools.description: Simulate repaying Aave V3 debt on Sepolia. The server compiles approve -> Pool.repay as an ERC-4337 batch.

on_behalf_of.description: Optional debt owner; defaults to agent wallet

tools.name: ardent_aave_repay_execute
tools.description: Execute repaying Aave V3 debt on Sepolia. In manual mode may return payment_required (402).

on_behalf_of.description: Optional debt owner; defaults to agent wallet

payment_proof.description: Optional value to encode as JSON in X-Payment-Proof header

tools.name: ardent_aave_borrow_simulate
tools.description: Simulate borrowing from Aave V3 on Sepolia. The server checks projected health factor before simulating the Pool.borrow call.

on_behalf_of.description: Optional debt owner; defaults to agent wallet

min_health_factor.description: Minimum projected health factor after borrow; default 1.05; must be at least 1.0

tools.name: ardent_aave_borrow_execute
tools.description: Execute borrowing from Aave V3 on Sepolia after projected health-factor guard. In manual mode may return payment_required (402).

on_behalf_of.description: Optional debt owner; defaults to agent wallet

min_health_factor.description: Minimum projected health factor after borrow; default 1.05; must be at least 1.0

payment_proof.description: Optional value to encode as JSON in X-Payment-Proof header

tools.name: ardent_aave_position
tools.description: Read Aave V3 Sepolia account data for an agent wallet, including collateral, debt, available borrows, LTV, liquidation threshold, and health factor.

tools.name: ardent_aave_balances
tools.description: Read wallet, supplied aToken, stable debt, and variable debt balances for all supported Aave V3 Sepolia reserve assets.

tools.description: Execute creating a GMX V2 Arbitrum Sepolia market_increase or market_swap order. In manual mode may return payment_required (402).
